panels.title: Lifecycle Failure Throughput by Event Type
Lifecycle Processing Duration by Event Type

targets.expr: sum by (event_type) (rate(ckc_record_age_sum{consumer_id="order_lifecycle", error="none"}[30s])) / clamp_min(sum by (event_type) (rate(ckc_record_age_count{consumer_id="order_lifecycle", error="none"}[30s])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Lifecycle Successful Record Age by Event Type

targets.expr: sum by (topic) (rate(ckc_record_age_sum{consumer_id="cauldron_telemetry", error="none"}[30s])) / clamp_min(sum by (topic) (rate(ckc_record_age_count{consumer_id="cauldron_telemetry", error="none"}[30s])), 1e-9)
1000 * sum by (job, instance, gc) (rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum[30s])) / clamp_min(sum by (job, instance, gc) (rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count[30s])), 1e-9)
